00722.purpose: Treatment before surgery for HER2-positive breast cancer.
00722.schedule: Four medicines by drip on Day 1, every 21 days for six cycles. Delays or stopping earlier may be needed.

phases.title: After surgery
phases.text: Pathology guides the next treatment; HER2 therapy has its own plan.

monitoring.test: Blood count, kidney/liver function, GFR and heart function

monitoring.when: Every 12 weeks during trastuzumab and at completion; earlier for concerns

cycle_expectations: Fatigue, bowel or mouth symptoms may occur between visits.
Report infection symptoms or new breathlessness promptly.
preparation: Follow your steroid and anti-sickness prescription; ask about growth-factor support.
00722.card_schedule: Four medicines on Day 1 every 21 days; surgery follows the chemotherapy course.

00485.purpose: Chemotherapy before or after surgery for early breast cancer.
00485.schedule: Four AC treatments every 14 days, then 12 weekly paclitaxel doses starting 14 days after the last AC. About 20 weeks without delays.

phases.title: AC phase
phases.text: Four treatments, 14 days apart; prescribed G-CSF support.

phases.title: Paclitaxel phase
phases.text: Twelve weekly doses; the premedicines change.

monitoring.when: Baseline and before each cycle; team confirms weekly-dose checks
Echo/MUGA if over 65 or indicated; other checks as needed
Depends on surgery timing and your treatment plan

cycle_expectations: Symptoms may occur on any day.
Report fever, chest symptoms or worsening numbness.
preparation: Use the current phase’s supportive medicines.
00485.card_schedule: AC every 14 days ×4; then paclitaxel weekly ×12. Record the phase with each entry.

cycle_blocks.label: Phase change
cycle_blocks.text: Paclitaxel starts 14 days after the last AC

00525.purpose: Ribociclib with endocrine treatment to control advanced breast cancer.
00525.schedule: Ribociclib daily on Days 1–21, then seven days off. Endocrine treatment follows its own schedule. Continue while beneficial and tolerated.

phases.title: Days 1–21
phases.text: Take prescribed ribociclib; continue endocrine treatment.

phases.title: Days 22–28
phases.text: No planned ribociclib; endocrine treatment continues.

monitoring.when: Every two weeks in cycles 1–2; before cycles 3–6
Electrolytes before cycles 1–6; ECG at cycle 1 Day 14
Further tests as indicated; scans follow your plan

cycle_expectations: Report fever, fainting, palpitations or new breathing symptoms.
preparation: Confirm the endocrine partner and injection appointments; do not replace missed doses.
00525.card_schedule: Ribociclib Days 1–21 of 28; endocrine partner has a separate continuing schedule.

00216.purpose: Tablet chemotherapy for breast or colorectal cancer; confirm your treatment aim.
00216.schedule: Capecitabine twice daily on Days 1–14, followed by seven days off. Adjuvant treatment is usually eight cycles; advanced treatment continues according to benefit and tolerance.

phases.title: Days 1–14
phases.text: Take tablets with food or within 30 minutes afterwards.

phases.title: Days 15–21
phases.text: Planned tablet break; symptoms may continue.

monitoring.test: Blood count, kidneys, liver and DPD testing
monitoring.when: DPD before first treatment unless already tested
Before each cycle; earlier if needed

cycle_expectations: Stop tablets and call for significant bowel, mouth or hand-foot symptoms.
preparation: Do not replace missed doses or restart after a toxicity hold without instructions.
00216.card_schedule: Twice daily Days 1–14; no capecitabine Days 15–21. Confirm total course with team.

00250.purpose: Chemotherapy after surgery to reduce breast cancer recurrence risk.
00250.schedule: Docetaxel and cyclophosphamide on Day 1 every 21 days, for four to six cycles. Confirm your planned number.

phases.title: Chemotherapy
phases.text: Both medicines at each treatment visit.

phases.title: After chemotherapy
phases.text: Radiotherapy follows if needed; agree further treatment and follow-up.

monitoring.test: Repeat blood tests and symptom review
monitoring.when: Team arranges tests; NCCP specifies repeats as clinically indicated
Individual appointments; no universal scan interval

cycle_expectations: Report fever, sudden illness, worsening numbness or swelling.
preparation: Take docetaxel steroids as prescribed; reconcile with anti-sickness medicines.
00250.card_schedule: Both medicines on Day 1 every 21 days. Team confirms four or six cycles.
